text_elements.text: When Li-ion Battery Controller (LBC) detects a malfunction of the Li-ion battery, it enters the control mode that protects the battery by stopping or restricting the output/charging from/to the battery.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: The fail-safe mode differs depending on the contents of the detected malfunction.
text_elements.label: text

text_elements.text: Pattern A: No driving, Charge stop, and EV system warning lamp illuminate
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Pattern B: Driving output power limit, Charge stop, and EV system warning lamp illuminate
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Pattern C: Driving output power limit, Charge limit, and EV system warning lamp illuminate
text_elements.label: list_item

text_elements.text: Pattern D: EV system warning lamp illuminate
text_elements.label: list_item
